title: Structural Constraint Integration in Generative Model for Discovery of Quantum Material Candidates
excerpt: We present a novel approach to integrating structural constraints in generative models for quantum material discovery, enabling more accurate predictions of material properties through advanced machine learning techniques.
citation: Okabe, R., et al. (2024). "Structural Constraint Integration in Generative Model for Discovery of Quantum Material Candidates." arXiv preprint arXiv:2407.04557.
